metadata.title: On nilpotent Lie algebras arising from parabolic subalgebras and quivers --- three-step cases
metadata.abstract: Nilpotent Lie groups are important subjects for studying spacial left-invariant geometric structures. However, nilpotent Lie groups are impossible to classify, and even the two-step case has not been classified. There are several classes of examples of nilpotent Lie algebras that arise with higher nilpotency steps. In this paper, we focus on two of these methods. The first one is the nilpotent parts of parabolic subalgebras of semisimple Lie algebras. The second one is the nilpotent Lie algebras obtained by quivers. We list and compare nilpotent Lie algebras obtained by these two methods that are three-step and of dimension at most 10.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 列出并比较维数不超过十的三步幂零 Lie 代数中，分别来自半单代数抛物子代数幂零根与来自 quiver 的两类例子。
analysis.breakthrough: 整理两套常用构造在受限维数中的重合与差异。
analysis.limitations: 不是全部三步或全部低维幂零 Lie 代数分类。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
